observation: Dr. Ananya greets Ravi with his history open on her tablet; he smiles back with empty hands on the desk. Inspected at 25% (contact sheet), 100% (full panel) and 200% (face crops), and on the composed page.

anatomy.note: Ananya holds both tablet edges; Ravi's forearms rest on the desk with hands clasped loosely.

contact.note: Tablet in both of her hands; his forearms on the desk top.

objects.note: Tablet shows three test-tube cards with check marks, no text or values.

faces.note: Faces match the sheets at 200%; see faceIdentity.

background.note: Consultation room with window and plant; top wall trimmed so the art fills the panel width. One small off-model dot under Ananya's right eye was filled with skin colour (tools/spot-remove.py).

continuity.note: Ananya low bun, gold stud, teal kurta, white coat, stethoscope; Ravi no bag.

lettering.note: Balloon in the wall gap between their heads with its tail to Ananya; closing caption on the plain desk front below his hands.

issues.description: Earlier takes gave Ananya a Meera-like braid, one returned an unrelated group, and two put heads or hands inside the lettering areas; retake 4 fixed these.

traits: almond eyes with slightly heavy lids and gentle downward outer corners visible
oval face with pointed chin and small rounded nose; low bun and gold stud match the sheet
narrow warm eyes creasing at the corners
thick straight dark brows close to the eyes
square jaw with short trimmed beard and broad nose
